text:
sara: Quick follow-up on the crediting + fanout contract refactor I sketched. posted the draft in the RFC repo: https://git.redwood/rfcs/crediting-fanout
mike: Nice. core split question: should serving emit per-token lines or compact per-request aggregates and trust downstream expansion?
anya: per-token is golden for audits but very chatty. compact saves bandwidth/throughput. hybrid seems required.
patrick: We also need deterministic expansion for replaying audits. If expansion is non-deterministic we'll fail reconciliations.
sara: Proposed hybrid: runtime emits compact "oplog" entries with a deterministic fingerprint and token counts. a downstream finalizer can expand on-demand and store expansion artifacts.
mike: How do we ensure finalizer determinism? stable sort keys + fingerprinting like we use in ingest.
anya: Yep. Include model_version, prompt_hash, sampling_seed in the compact event so expansion is reproducible. Example shape I added to RFC:
```
{ "request_id": "r_99102", "tenant": "acme", "fingerprint": "fp:sha256(...)", "tokens": 128, "buckets": [{"model":"redwood-7b","count":128}], "compact": true }
```
patrick: Add a `source_seq` from runtime to help idempotency checks on finalizer.
sara: Shard key idea: hash(tenant) % N combined with time-bucket to prevent single-tenant hotspot while keeping colocation for finalization.
mike: Late arrivals: watermark policy + TTL. I suggest 7-day full-fidelity expansion window, 90-day compact-only retention. after 90d we evict compact bodies.
anya: For audits older than 7d, finalizer will expand from compact but it will be slower/approximate if parts missing.
patrick: Finalizer should write expansion artifact back to archive + ledger pointer and a checksum. audits assert checksum to avoid re-expansion drift.
sara: Operational safety: finalizer must be lease-protected and resumable to avoid double-charges on crashes. Also idempotent commits to ledger.
mike: Fast-path: for tiny requests (tokens < 16) runtime can emit expanded events directly. enforce per-tenant rate-limits for direct expands to avoid DoS.
anya: Cost analysis TODO: I'll estimate costs for keeping full expands vs compact-only vs hybrid by EOW.
patrick: I'll add artifact schema (pointer, checksum, created_by, source_seq) to ledger contract tomorrow.
sara: Action items:
- sara: update RFC with shard key + pseudo-flow (today)
- mike: prototype finalizer lease+resume (next week)
- anya: cost estimate (EOW)
- patrick: artifact schema on ledger (tomorrow)

sara: Any objections? if none I'll mark RFC as "follow-up: implement plan" and schedule a 30m sync.
anya: No objections. :+1:
mike: All good.
patrick: SGTM.
